blogs.title: Breaking the Speed Limit: How FlashAttention-3 Unlocks the Future of Long-Context AI
blogs.description: An accessible overview of the attention bottleneck in modern Transformers and how FlashAttention-3 tackles it. This post will introduce the paper's main goals, explaining why scaling to long-context applications is hard and how this new algorithm achieves a 1.5-2.0x speedup over its predecessor on Hopper GPUs.

blogs.title: The Art of Multitasking: Warp-Specialization and the Asynchronous GPU
blogs.description: A deep dive into the hardware-level magic of FlashAttention-3. This post breaks down the complex concepts of 'producer-consumer asynchrony' and 'pingpong scheduling' using everyday analogies, showing how the algorithm keeps the GPU's Tensor Cores busy by overlapping data movement, matrix multiplication, and softmax calculations.

blogs.title: Double the Speed, Double the Accuracy: The FP8 Revolution in FlashAttention-3
blogs.description: An exploration of how FlashAttention-3 leverages FP8 low-precision hardware to nearly double throughput without sacrificing accuracy. The post will explain the clever mathematical tricks of 'block quantization' and 'incoherent processing' that actually reduce numerical errors by 2.6x compared to standard methods.

blogs.title: From Benchmarks to Real-World Impact: What 1.2 PFLOPs/s Actually Means for Developers
blogs.description: A results-focused post translating the paper's impressive benchmarks (reaching up to 740 TFLOPs/s in FP16 and 1.2 PFLOPs/s in FP8) into tangible benefits. It will cover what these speeds mean for practical applications like coding assistants, long-document reasoning, and high-res video processing, along with how developers can access the open-source code.
